svg.title: 2-D FFT by the row–column method: 1-D FFTs along rows, transpose, rows again
svg.text: Xuv = Σm ωMum (Σn xmn ωNvn): the inner sum is a DFT of each row, the outer
one a DFT of each column. Transposing (through shared-memory tiles) turns the column
pass into contiguous row FFTs, so every FFT pass reads memory coalesced.
